jess_support: Hey folks — escalation from NimbusSearch: embeddings endpoint intermittently returning DimensionMismatchError and big p99 tail spikes during batching. They report ~0.3-0.8% errors; latency jumps from ~40ms to ~1.1s during busy windows. thread_ts: 2209991111
alex_eng: can you paste a sanitized request/response and the exact API route? Are they hitting a model alias that maps multiple variants?
jess_support: sanitized request they sent:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Body: {"model":"redwood-embed-xlarge-v1","input":["hello","world"], "client_id":"nimbus-search"}
```
sample response error:
```
{"error":{"message":"DimensionMismatchError: expected 1536 but got 1024 for request index 1","code":"dim_mismatch"}}
```
They attached runtime batch logs showing the coalescer briefly grouping items with mixed embedding dims then rejecting some.
samir_runtime: sounds like two things colliding: (1) client sometimes sends requests for two different model variants (1536 vs 1024 dims) under the same client_id; (2) dynamic coalescer is trying to fill to max_batch_size=64 and ends up waiting, causing tail queueing. Any recent app-side rollout at Nimbus?
jess_support: Nimbus says they started a gradual client-side rollout last week and increased parallel workers. They didn't realize the rollout would flip model variant for a subset.
maria_sre: grabbed a snippet from runtime:
```
[coalescer] batch_id=bf7e size=60 total_tokens=9840 variant_counts={redwood-embed-xlarge-v1:38, redwood-embed-medium-v1:22}
[coalescer] validate: dims=[1536,1024] -> rejecting 22 items -> DimensionMismatchError
[queue] p99_wait_ms=1100
```
alex_eng: that explains the dim errors. For tail latency, dynamic batching mixes variants which increases wait time as coalescer tries to reach max_batch_size. Mitigations:
- immediate: apply per-client max_batch_size override (e.g., 8 or 16) for nimbus-search
- immediate: route that client to a single pinned variant (if acceptable)
- short-term runtime change: add coalescer guard to avoid coalescing across differing model dims; prefer emitting smaller homogeneous batches faster
- longer-term: factor model_dim into the batching key
samir_runtime: if Nimbus can't change their rollout, we can set a routing policy to pin client_id=nimbus-search to the 1536 model. Also can flip a config: coalescer.reject_on_dim_mismatch=true to reject before waiting. I'll prototype the config in staging and add coalescer_mismatch_count metric.
jess_support: Nimbus asked for a repro script — here's what they used (sanitized):
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in $(seq 1 300); do
  if (( i % 7 == 0 )); then model="redwood-embed-medium-v1"; else model="redwood-embed-xlarge-v1"; fi
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -H "X-Client-Id: nimbus-search" \
    -d '{"model":"'"$model"'","input":["test payload"]}' &
  sleep 0.02
done
wait
```
This reproduces mixed-dim rejects and intermittent p99 spikes.
